summary: Notify the website deployment workflow when published documentation changes on main

replay.detail: No replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No persistent schema or stored data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: No CLI, API or runtime behavior changes. Pushes to main affecting docs/site send a fractal-docs-changed repository dispatch to the website repository.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or additional runtime work.

manual.detail: Configure FRACTAL_SITE_DISPATCH_TOKEN in this repository with Contents: write on compoundingtech/private, and enable its Deploy sites receiver workflow. Documentation notifications fail with a clear error if the dispatch token is absent.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes. A missed notification can be recovered by manually dispatching the website deployment workflow.
